page_title: DOR 3-1 BOC | Dortmund v Bochum 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+6' Some great controlled play and passing from Dortmund. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Manuel Riemann to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
90+1' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Dortmund.
89' A yellow-coloured card is received by Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).

87' This was a piece of cake for Alexander Meyer. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
86' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) commits a rough foul. Benjamin Brand stops the game and makes a call.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jadon Sancho leaves the pitch and Mats Hummels (Dortmund) comes on.
83' Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
82' 12:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
81' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Antwi-Adjei trots off the pitch and is replaced by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
80' Thomas Letsch decides to make a substitution. Moritz Broschinski will be replaced by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
80' A substitution has been made. Anthony Losilla goes off and Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) comes on.
79' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) tries his luck with a low long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Alexander Meyer has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
78' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
77' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
76' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bochum was in an offside position.
75' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
74' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
74' Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

72' 2 - 1 Marcel Sabitzer showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 2:1.
71' Substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Donyell Malen walks off.
70' Some patient build-up play from Dortmund as they look to unlock the defence.
68' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) replacing Tim Oermann.
66' Today's match ends for Youssoufa Moukoko who will be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).

64' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
63' Matus Bero (Bochum) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' The corner from Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is cleared away by the defence.
59' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
59' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

58' A pass into the box finds Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alexander Meyer denies him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
56' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Donyell Malen (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
54' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
54' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
51' Ooh that was close! Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
50' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
49' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
49' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+3' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
44' Bochum are ruled offside.
44' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and it's Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

42' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
42' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund).
42' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Dortmund will take a corner kick.
42' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
37' A pass from Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) is intercepted by Manuel Riemann and the move breaks down.
37' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

37' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Manuel Riemann to dive and make a save. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
36' The free kick will be taken by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund).
35' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Matus Bero (Bochum). Benjamin Brand saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
35' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
34' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Alexander Meyer was alert and made an amazing save!
32' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
31' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) sends a short pass into the box, Youssoufa Moukoko takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety.
31' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) sends an accurate short pass. Niclas Fullkrug controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
29' Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' Christopher Antwi-Adjei finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Patrick Osterhage (Bochum).
28' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) brings his opponent down. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Bochum are awarded the free kick.
26' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
25' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ian Maatsen.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
23' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
22' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
22' The ball is cleared after Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
22' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) releases Jadon Sancho, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
21' That's unlucky! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
18' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
16' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
15' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Referee Benjamin Brand sees the trip by Kevin Stoger (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
13' One of the players from Bochum times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' There's an opportunity for Kevin Stoger (Bochum) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

12' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
8' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into the bottom left corner.
6' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
4' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul after Manuel Riemann (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Dortmund!
3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Manuel Riemann (Bochum) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
2' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) brought his opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
Bochum will kick-off.
Benjamin Brand got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
